meta.name: Operation Safed Sagar
meta.description: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

videos.title: Peace and War
videos.overview: Flight commander Ajay Ahuja is called in to train the Golden Arrows. As the Indo-Pak peace talks begin, General Musharraf considers his next move.

videos.title: Sada-e-Sarhad
videos.overview: Baldy struggles to get his head in the game, but a unique bonding exercise brings the squad together. As they celebrate, trouble looms in the mountains.

videos.title: Safed Sagar
videos.overview: General Musharraf and the prime minister lock horns. The Golden Arrows race to uncover the infiltrators, but a shocking incident jolts the squadron.

videos.title: Golden Arrows
videos.overview: Panic grips the Indian forces as the Kargil War quickly escalates and Ahuja is pulled into peril. Amid nationwide outrage, a plan to fight back emerges.

videos.title: Bombs Away
videos.overview: A high-altitude bombing strategy brings new challenges for the Golden Arrows. As Dhali grapples with guilt, General Musharraf's plans begin to unravel.

videos.title: Line of Control
videos.overview: As international pressure mounts, a bold formation tactic could signal a momentous shift as the war reaches a turning point.

meta.slogan: The  Untold Story of the Kargil War
